notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h1] Norman's Night In came out 1 YEAR AGO!
[/h1]
It's crazy to think how far this little game has brought us. Our first big recognition was way back in 2016 when we had nothing but a novel idea and a few broken levels. Disheveled and sleepless, we glued together what we could, taped the rest, and miraculously won a nomination for Best Game at the first ever Google Play Indie Game Festival. We were absolutely thrilled and doubled down on making the best game we could.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34570300/fdd5b2863589d55180bd25d688ceda4674918f4b.png[/img]

Fast forward almost 4 years, just as disheveled and sleepless and launching our very first game as a 2-man studio! We look back with a lot of dang pride for the not-so-little game we built. Hand-painted/animated everything, 35+ interconnected Metroidvania levels, sprawling and ever-changing world. It was the hardest project we've made and something that we hold a lot of pride in. 

To everyone who has supported us along the way, for the hundreds of messages, the fanart, and enthusiasm for Norman's Night In, we [b]thank you[/b]. You have truly made this experience special for us.

Nick Iorfino & Alex Reed
Bactrian Games

notes.title: CONTROLLER SUPPORT & Indie MEGABOOTH Going Away (For Now) Sale!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34570300/1dcd0dc10510375fad6139b1de15771e9cda074a.png[/img]

Controller Support is NOW AVAILABLE! It's the perfect time to play the award-winning slingshot metroidvania about an old man, his bowling ball, and a fateful fall into the world of Cave.

[h3]For the next 7 days, [b]Norman's Night In[/b] is 40% off as part of the Indie MEGABOOTH Going Away (For Now) Sale![/h3]

The people behind the curtains of the Indie MEGABOOTH are incredible and passionate for indie games in a way that makes us proud to be independent. To support them during this difficult time, a portion of every sale of Norman's Night In will go directly to them. Their support over the years has been so important for our team and we're thrilled to have the opportunity to support them in return. 

Update 1.1.0 
Major Updates:
- Full Controller Support integration

Miscellaneous:
- Major improvements to the backend save structure.
- Improved fidelity of certain cutscenes
- Time bug balancing

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed save state issues relating to open/closed doors
- Fixed problem with some save statues embedding Norman in conveyors
- Fixed instances of unpopulated Red Flame bulbs
- Fixed instances of leeches/green beans vanishing when leaving platforms

Norman's Night In will be 40% OFF from May 5th to May 12th!

notes.title: Controller Support Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We had an incredible time with the Indie MEGABOOTH at PAX East. A sincere thank you to everyone who came out to say hi and play the latest from Norman’s Night In!

Those who stopped by our booth had the chance to play Norman’s Night In with a controller! We’re super excited to announce controller support will be available soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34570300/066558ad709ed74e2e3631b675cd87d7e662b247.jpg[/img]

Watching people play and enjoy our game is, without question, the coolest part of what we do. Having a stage as big as PAX East is humbling to say the least. We were honored to showcase with the Indie MEGABOOTH for a second time. 

Thanks again to everyone who came by the booth at PAX and made it such a memorable one!

- Nick and Alex

notes.title: PAX East 2020 Indie MEGABOOTH!
notes.content:
Norman’s Night In will be at PAX East 2020 as part of the Indie MEGABOOTH! We’re both incredibly excited about it. If you’re going to PAX East, we would love to see you there.

We’ll be at the Indie MINIBOOTH on Saturday (2/29) and Sunday (3/1)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34570300/b41870c5f619f9e43142444282838cfb1e5fd5c9.jpg[/img]

PAX East holds a special place in our hearts. It’s where we won the PAX East Indie Showcase and met so many incredible peeps. It’s been a crazy year and to have the opportunity to showcase alongside the incredible people and devs at Indie MEGABOOTH, now that Norman’s Night In is out in the wild, means a lot to us.

Thank you, as always, for the support and hope to see you there!

- Nick & Alex

notes.title: Norman's Night In is Now Available!
notes.content:
After almost 4 years of development and more support than we ever could have expected, we did the thing! Norman's Night In is now available!!
[previewyoutube=YxaxnxTVXxU;full][/previewyoutube]
Norman’s Night In is a slingshot adventure game that tells the tale of an old man, his new bowling ball, and a fateful fall into the world of Cave. Use slingshot mechanics to solve physics-based puzzles, face unfamiliar cave beasties, and discover the unseen world by the light of your new bowling ball.

Every level of Norman’s Night In is hand crafted and hand painted. Upgrade your bowling ball to access new abilities, uncover secrets, and continue your descent into the interconnected world below.

2019 PAX East Indie Showcase - Winner
2019 PAX West Indie MEGABOOTH - Official Selection

"You can just feel what a labor of love this is." - Touch Arcade

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34570300/30d70abc42ce8a3662fa270050f58e777796f920.gif[/img]

Controller support coming soon! :D

If you have any questions or technical difficulties, please email us at normansnightin@gmail.com with as much information as possible!

Thank you and enjoy!!

- Nick & Alex

notes.title: Release Date Update - Oct 2, 2019
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34570300/a6f5221a3f713d90a5cd79f87832d16f0362c5f7.jpg[/img]

Hello!

Nick here. I just wanted to send you a quick note and share some release news with you.

As some of you may have seen, earlier this week, Apple announced big changes to the app store coming September 19th, one day after our September 18th launch. It was difficult news to process because of how much of an impact it will have on our release.

As a self-publishing team of 2, getting press, being featured on various store fronts, and word of mouth are some of our best tools for a successful launch. Launching one day before such a large change undercuts the potential coverage and feature opportunities we have. With iOS being such a big market for us, we’ve decided to push the release a couple weeks and hope for less turbulent waters.

Norman’s Night In will be available October 2, 2019 on Steam, Google Play, and the App Store!

It was a difficult decision to make, but we’re optimistic! We’ve put so much time and love into this game; after almost 4 years of development, what’s another 2 weeks. If anyone asks, tell them we’re giving Apple some room to breathe--we’d hate to overshadow them on their big day :)

Regarding development, things are going really well! I’ll follow up with more specifics in a future post, but suffice to say, PAX West was awesome, the game is in a great place, and we’re excited to have you play it. 

Until next time,
Nick
Bactrian Games

You can find the original post here: https://www.bactriangames.com/devlog/2019/9/12/release-date-update


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034870/Normans_Night_In/

notes.title: PAX East and Dev Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34570300/d4d9d87215b314fe2b28a4ba4f48b7177d51576a.png[/img]

[h1]We're back from PAX East 2019[/h1]
And have been for a little while now :)

As a brief recap: The folks at Penny Arcade were gracious enough to select Norman's Night In as [b]PAX East 2019 Indie Showcase Winners[/b]. We were lucky enough to be 1 of 4 awesome indie games chosen to showcase, and saying that still feels weird!

The 2 of us have been developing Norman's Night In for more than 3 years, and watching people (700+ in 4 days!!) play, enjoy, laugh, and share the thing we've worked so hard to make is flippin magical.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34570300/c60bd2f41c0979b2d82afde5cac1ba959e93c1b6.png[/img]

With PAX East complete and our sleep schedules wrangled back to normalcy, we're excited to be heads-down on finishing Norman's Night In. 

[h1] DEV UPDATE![/h1]
Over the last month, we've extended our playable platforms and now have NNI running smoothly on PC, Android, and iOS! We also added fancy new controller support, which might be my favorite update this month. We've also been adding final art throughout the game including brand new levels that we'll be BETA testing in the near future. 

We're very happy with how development is going! Things are coming together, Norman's Night In is starting to look shiny thanks to the vigorous polish we're applying, and people are being nice to us on the internet. Onwards to profit so we can keep doing this awesome thing we're passionate about (and finally feed our physical bodies)!

[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]
I'd like to briefly thank everyone who stopped by our booth at PAX East. Your support is very-much appreciated :) We'd also like to thank PAX East and everyone involved in the Indie Showcase--great games and great people all around.

[h1]WISHLIST[/h1]
Don't forget to Wishlist NNI if you haven't already. (Oh hey! I just realized I can make this fancy wishlist widget)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034870/Normans_Night_In/
Press that green button ^

Until next time,

Nick & Alex
[url=https://www.bactriangames.com/]Bactrian Games[/url]

[/h1]

This is an absolute honor for us. We’ll be showcasing Norman's Night In at the PAX Indie Showcase booth alongside 3 other incredible indie developers. It’s been a stretch goal of ours for a very long time and we couldn’t be more excited! You can find the announcement and more information about the 3 other awesome games here: http://east.paxsite.com/indie

If you’ll be at PAX East, come say hi and [b]play our demo[/b]! We'll be at booth 15120 all 4 days and we’d love to show you everything that's new with Norman (and give you some free PAX exclusive stuff)!

[h1]That's it! That's the update![/h1] 

Thanks to everyone for the support and kind words following the PAX announcement, it's been really awesome to hear from you all. We'll have more information for you very soon. As always, you can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BactrianGames] Twitter [/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/bactriangames] Facebook [/url] and don't forget to Wishlist on Steam.
